name: Seduce Me: The Beach Episode
source:
"We're going WHERE?!"

A small vacation away from suburban life never hurt anyone; especially if the destination had warm breezes and cool beaches on every corner.

Who will you spend time with?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我们要去哪里？！”

远离郊区生活的短暂假期不会伤害任何人；特别是如果目的地的每个角落都有温暖的微风和凉爽的海滩。

你会和谁一起度过时光？
